# Getting Started

This article walks you through how to implement a solution using **Python** and **R**, with output samples, code comparisons, and tips for both.

## Python Code Example

```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "score": [85, 90, 78]
})

df["grade"] = pd.cut(df["score"], bins=[0, 80, 90, 100], labels=["C", "B", "A"])
df
```


## R Code Example

```r
library(dplyr)

df <- data.frame(
  name = c("Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"),
  score = c(85, 90, 78)
)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(grade = cut(score, breaks = c(0, 80, 90, 100), labels = c("C", "B", "A")))

print(df)

```
